name: Person Identification Data (PID)
description: EUDI Person Identification Data of a natural person.
summary: Credential type template for eu.europa.ec.eudi.pid.1, the EU Digital Identity (EUDI) Person Identification Data of a natural person, in sd_jwt_vc format without a schema. Claim names follow the EUDI PID rulebook. Subject form groups: Person (given_name, family_name, birth_date, age_over_18, nationality) and Issuance (issuing_country, issuing_authority). Issued by the eudi/pid_issuer and verified by the eudi/pid_verifier wallet templates.
